row.evidence: Halo sells one plan with "no tiers, no bolt-ons" and includes a Single Sign-On module (SAML, OIDC, Entra, Okta, Google), but no SCIM endpoint appears in its 991 public guides; users and agents come in through Halo-run Okta, Entra ID and Google Workspace imports, SSO JIT creation or CSV import.
row.notes: New in 2026-09. halopsa.com/pricing redirects to usehalo.com/pricing: one platform at one per-agent price (US $99/agent/mo billed annually for 1-24 agents, $95 for 25-49, $89 for 50-99, $85 for 100-249 per the page's region data; GBP £69 is the UK default), named or concurrent licences, onboarding packages required, and a $1M/yr Enterprise Package. No SCIM by absence (medium): the pricing page, every guide title in the usehalo.com sitemap, the API guides and the Okta OIN search show no SCIM. Provisioning is vendor-run directory sync: the Halo Integrator pulls users and agents from Okta (API token), Entra ID (Graph) and Google Workspace on a schedule and deactivates them when they are disabled or missing; roles map from IdP groups. SSO can also create users on first sign-in. The Halo REST API (OAuth client credentials or static API key, per-tenant reference) is included in the single plan; API-only agents need no licence.

plans.name: Halo Enterprise Package
plans.price_text: $1M per year, unlimited licences and funded implementation

scim.notes: No SCIM endpoint in any of the 991 guides listed in the usehalo.com sitemap, the SSO/SAML guides or the API guides; false is by absence (rule 5). IdP integrations are Halo-run pulls, not SCIM.

auth.notes: Client ID and secret impersonating an agent whose roles limit permissions; static API key as a fallback.

limitations.text: The endpoint reference is served from each customer's instance; no public endpoint list was found, so endpoints are not recorded.

okta.notes: No OIN app; Halo pulls users/agents with an Okta API token and deactivates non-active statuses on the next import.

entra.notes: Halo's Entra integration imports users and agents via Graph; disabled Azure users become disabled agents.

fallbacks.other_sync: Halo Integrator directory sync from Okta, Microsoft Entra ID and Google Workspace
fallbacks.notes: JIT documented in the SSO module (OIDC/Entra/Okta/Google); SAML 2.0 also supported.
